The implementation is complete. Let me update HANDOFF.md with the milestone 2 notes (including the conflict resolution) and do a final verification run.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && printf '%s\\n' '# tinydb milestone 2 - HANDOFF' '' 'BatchWriter(db) in tinydb/journal.py wraps a TinyDB instance, default table only.' '' 'R01: apply(ops) validates list of op dicts (insert/remove), returns inserted IDs, empty->[], malformed->ValueError.' 'R02: atomic - deep-copied storage snapshot before batch; on any error restore default table + reset table._next_id + clear_cache; missing remove id is an error; previously acquired handles see success and rollback.' 'R03: ordinary API intact; deep-copy on insert, no aliasing in either direction.' 'R04: bool doc_id rejected (bool is int subclass but not a valid ID); structural validation before any commit (non-list ops, non-dict ops, non-dict/missing document, unknown op, missing keys all raise ValueError before state changes); empty dict documents accepted.' 'R05: preview(ops) simulates on a deep-copied snapshot of current table data; never writes, never consumes/advances IDs (uses handle _next_id if set, else max+1 - matches Table._get_next_id), errors leave everything unchanged; returned list is fresh and detached (R05b) - mutating it has no effect on later previews or writer state; existing table handles and query caches untouched (preview only reads storage).' 'R05 clarification: successful apply advances the table _next_id counter (via _get_next_id/_update_table) and persists it through the storage write, so subsequent inserts via apply or direct db.insert continue the sequence without reuse/rewind, even across removes; failed apply restores _next_id (no IDs consumed).' 'R06: no stale initial snapshot - every call re-reads db.storage.read() fresh, so direct db.insert between calls is seen by apply and preview.' '' 'Conflict resolution: older generated note said preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted. That note is unverified and superseded by R04/R05: preview never consumes IDs (tested) and bool doc_ids are rejected (tested). Recorded in BatchWriter class docstring.' '' 'Tests: tests/test_journal.py (124 tests, memory + JSON file storage). Public acceptance_public.py passes. Full tests/ + acceptance_public.py = 350 passed.' 'Notes: use `where(...)` for queries; run pytest with `-o addopts=` (pytest.ini adds cov flags). Storage may keep doc IDs as strings (JSON) - preview normalises to int.' > HANDOFF.md && python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q -o addopts= 2>&1 | tail -3"}
